name: Stray
overview: Scripture commands believers to actively restore straying animals to their rightful owners, emphasizing responsibility and integrity in community relationships. The passages in Exodus 23:4 and Deuteronomy 22:1-3 instruct that whether the animal belongs to an enemy or a brother, one must not ignore it but ensure its return, even holding it safely if the owner is not nearby. This reflects a broader biblical principle of stewardship and love for one's neighbor, demonstrating obedience to God's law through practical acts of care and honesty.
